name: start_helper
description: Start a helper: a background agent that checks something on a schedule and reports only what changed. Returns at once with the helper's number. Its reports arrive later as notices; you never need to poll it.

title.description: A short name for what the helper watches, shown to the person. At most 60 characters.

brief.description: Everything the helper needs: what to watch, where (URLs), what counts as worth reporting, and when to stop early. It cannot talk to the person; it can ask you.

every.description: How often to check, as a duration such as 5m or 1h. At least 1m. Default 15m.

duration.description: How long to keep watching, such as 2h or 72h. At most 168h. Default 24h.

name: message_helper
description: Send a message to one of your helpers, for example to answer its question.

text.description: What to tell it: an answer to its question, or a change to its brief.

name: stop_helper
description: Stop one of your helpers. It will not check again.

name: list_helpers
description: List your helpers with their state, schedule and number of reports.

name: stay_quiet
description: End this turn without saying anything to the person. Use it when a notice, such as a helper's routine report, needs no reply.

reason.description: Why nothing needs saying. Not shown to the person.
